project.name: Rift Rumble
project.summary: Draft-based League of Legends community for amateur players: individuals sign up, approved captains draft teams; weekly Lower Elo (Bronze to low Platinum) and Higher Elo (high Platinum to Masters 200LP) matches, then playoffs and championship broadcasts.

about.text: Draft-based League of Legends community for amateur players: individuals sign up, approved captains draft teams; weekly Lower Elo (Bronze to low Platinum) and Higher Elo (high Platinum to Masters 200LP) matches, then playoffs and championship broadcasts. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Riot Games.
Audience as stated or implied by the page: Amateur players in two Elo bands; region not stated
